answer_result.answer: Dave aims to build a custom car from scratch, work on classic cars, keep learning auto engineering, and share his passion with others (including through a car-mod blog). He also describes doing what he loves as a job as his goal since childhood.

question.question: What does Dave aim to do with his passion for cars?

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-05-03, stated his dream is to someday build a custom car from scratch; plans to keep learning more about auto engineering to get there [S5T5].

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - Opening the shop was his dream and is a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars [S4T3][S4T5].

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-08-11, got picked for a car mod workshop — called it "a dream come true", since he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car (ties to his stated dream of building a custom car from scratch, see ## Classic cars); Calvin congratulated him [S13T1][S13T3].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - Passionate about fixing up things in general: "more than just a hobby" — it gives him a sense of achievement and purpose [S7T6].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-09-02, when telling Calvin he's been tied up with car stuff, said fixing stuff up and seeing it turn out better is "really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose", and that fixing someone's car makes him feel like he's "making a difference"; he's made "proud" to see the relief on someone's face when their car is fixed (echoing his long-stated sense of purpose from fixing things, see above) [S17T3][S17T5].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-10-08, when telling Calvin about his car show and restored/modified car (details in ## Classic cars), said working on cars "is not just a hobby, it's a passion" — it's "like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress"; as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage, tinkering with engines — "it was like my own sanctuary" (echoing his childhood memories of working on cars with his dad, see above); now he's "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome" [S22T5].
- On 2023-10-08, said doing what he loves has been "my goal since I was a kid" and it's awesome that he's able to do it; restoring things can be tough but "the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great"; Calvin responded that bringing broken things back to life is "so satisfying," that working on cars "can be a real escape from reality" (he understands the feeling), and that "doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal," adding "Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." [S22T5][S22T6][S22T7].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked "what made you start working on cars?") that his car passion started when he was ten: he'd been fascinated with how machines work, found an old car in a neighbor's garage, and asked if he could fix it — "that's when my love for car engineering began!" — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; comes with his remark that working on a car is his outlet — "a little oasis of calm" — where he's "connecting back with myself" — see the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; complements the childhood memories of tinkering with engines in his dad's garage recorded above; Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life.", and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is working on another project — Dave answered in the continuation of the same day's chat, which is not in this excerpt: he restored a car last year (2022, the 2022 restoration, see above) but sold it to a collector, and is now working on a new car project he finds quite a challenge [S25T14][S25T15][S25T16][S25T17].

- Called opening the shop a "labor of love" — challenging, but "so worth it"; feeling the hard work pay off is "like bringing something back to life" (echoing his car-restoration sentiment), and he finds it incredible that his skills and hard work made it happen [S4T9][S4T11][S4T13].
- Says the "perfect blend of dedication and passion" keeps him motivated and makes it all worthwhile; Calvin encouraged him to "keep going for it!" [S4T14][S4T15][S4T16].

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - Working on cars is what he's passionate about: doing it every day is "so rewarding", "seeing the transformation is awesome", and he finds it satisfying to help people keep their cars in good condition [S4T21].

evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-05-16, told Calvin the shop had opened the previous week (~2023-05-08/14) and that he had invited friends over to celebrate — "it's been amazing"; he's "super stoked to share [his] passion and help out with folks' rides" and it has "been incredible so far" [S6T8]. Note this conflicts with the 2023-05-01 statement that the shop had already opened (see above); the later date is recorded as stated.

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Car mod blog (new as of 2023-11-02)
evidence_items.speaker: Dave
evidence_items.text: - On 2023-11-02, told Calvin he recently started a blog on car mods — "It's my way to share my passion with others" — and asked Calvin for blogging tips (unanswered in this excerpt), sharing a photo of a car website design (Calvin's side in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S28T8].
